verses.english: Numbered Discourses 7.58
6. The Undeclared Points
Nothing to Hide

verses.pali: “Cattārimāni, bhikkhave, tathāgatassa arakkheyyāni, tīhi ca anupavajjo.
verses.english: “Mendicants, there are four areas where the Realized One has nothing to hide, and three ways he is irreproachable.
What are the four areas where the Realized One has nothing to hide?
His bodily behavior is pure.

verses.pali: natthi tathāgatassa kāyaduccaritaṁ yaṁ tathāgato rakkheyya:
verses.english: So the Realized One has no bodily misconduct to hide, thinking:
‘Don’t let others find this out about me!’
His verbal behavior is pure.

verses.pali: natthi tathāgatassa vacīduccaritaṁ yaṁ tathāgato rakkheyya:
verses.english: So the Realized One has no verbal misconduct to hide, thinking:
‘Don’t let others find this out about me!’
His mental behavior is pure.

verses.pali: natthi tathāgatassa manoduccaritaṁ yaṁ tathāgato rakkheyya:
verses.english: So the Realized One has no mental misconduct to hide, thinking:
‘Don’t let others find this out about me!’
His livelihood is pure.

verses.pali: natthi tathāgatassa micchāājīvo yaṁ tathāgato rakkheyya:
verses.english: So the Realized One has no wrong livelihood to hide, thinking:
‘Don’t let others find this out about me!’
These are the four areas where the Realized One has nothing to hide.
What are the three ways the Realized One is irreproachable?
The Realized One has explained the teaching well.

verses.pali: Tatra vata maṁ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṁ sahadhammena paṭicodessati:
verses.english: I see no reason for anyone—whether ascetic, brahmin, god, Māra, or the Divinity, or anyone else in the world—to legitimately scold me, saying:
‘For such and such reasons you haven’t explained the teaching well.’

verses.pali: Etamahaṁ, bhikkhave, nimittaṁ asamanupassanto khemappatto abhayappatto vesārajjappatto viharāmi.
verses.english: Since I see no such reason, I live secure, fearless, and self-assured.

verses.pali: Supaññattā kho pana me, bhikkhave, sāvakānaṁ nibbānagāminī paṭipadā.
verses.english: I have clearly described the practice that leads to extinguishment for my disciples.

verses.pali: Yathāpaṭipannā mama sāvakā āsavānaṁ khayā anāsavaṁ cetovimuttiṁ paññāvimuttiṁ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.
verses.english: Practicing in accordance with this, my disciples realize the undefiled freedom of heart and freedom by wisdom in this very life. And they live having realized it with their own insight due to the ending of defilements.

verses.pali: Tatra vata maṁ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṁ sahadhammena paṭicodessati:
verses.english: I see no reason for anyone—whether ascetic, brahmin, god, Māra, or the Divinity, or anyone else in the world—to legitimately scold me, saying:

verses.pali: ‘itipi te na supaññattā sāvakānaṁ nibbānagāminī paṭipadā. Yathāpaṭipannā tava sāvakā āsavānaṁ khayā …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantī’ti.
verses.english: ‘For such and such reasons you haven’t clearly described the practice that leads to extinguishment for your disciples.’

verses.pali: Etamahaṁ, bhikkhave, nimittaṁ asamanupassanto khemappatto abhayappatto vesārajjappatto viharāmi.
verses.english: Since I see no such reason, I live secure, fearless, and self-assured.

verses.pali: Anekasatā kho pana me, bhikkhave, sāvakaparisā āsavānaṁ khayā …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.
verses.english: Many hundreds in my assembly of disciples have realized the undefiled freedom of heart and freedom by wisdom in this very life. And they live having realized it with their own insight due to the ending of defilements.

verses.pali: Tatra vata maṁ samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā devo vā māro vā brahmā vā koci vā lokasmiṁ sahadhammena paṭicodessati:
verses.english: I see no reason for anyone—whether ascetic, brahmin, god, Māra, or the Divinity, or anyone else in the world—to legitimately scold me, saying:

verses.pali: ‘itipi te na anekasatā sāvakaparisā āsavānaṁ khayā anāsavaṁ cetovimuttiṁ paññāvimuttiṁ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantī’ti.
verses.english: ‘For such and such reasons you don’t have many hundreds of disciples in your following who have realized the undefiled freedom of heart and freedom by wisdom in this very life, and who live having realized it with their own insight due to the ending of defilements.’

verses.pali: Etamahaṁ, bhikkhave, nimittaṁ asamanupassanto khemappatto abhayappatto vesārajjappatto viharāmi.
verses.english: Since I see no such reason, I live secure, fearless, and self-assured.
These are the three ways the Realized One is irreproachable.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri tathāgatassa arakkheyyāni, imehi ca tīhi anupavajjo”ti.
verses.english: These are the four areas where the Realized One has nothing to hide, and the three ways he is irreproachable.”
